158:     def render_template(
159:         self, message: Message, tracker: DialogueStateTracker, flows: FlowsList
160:     ) -> str:
161:         """Render the jinja template to create the prompt for the LLM.
162: 
163:         Args:
164:             message: The current message from the user.
165:             tracker: The tracker containing the current state of the conversation.
166:             flows: The flows available to the user.
167: 
168:         Returns:
169:             The rendered prompt template.
170:         """
171:         flows_without_patterns = FlowsList(
172:             [f for f in flows.underlying_flows if not f.is_handling_pattern()]
173:         )
174:         top_relevant_frame = top_flow_frame(DialogueStack.from_tracker(tracker))
175:         top_flow = top_relevant_frame.flow(flows) if top_relevant_frame else None
176:         current_step = top_relevant_frame.step(flows) if top_relevant_frame else None
177:         if top_flow is not None:
178:             flow_slots = [
179:                 {
180:                     "name": info_step.collect,
181:                     "value": self.slot_value(tracker, info_step.collect),
182:                     "type": tracker.slots[info_step.collect].type_name,
183:                     "allowed_values": self.allowed_values_for_slot(
184:                         tracker.slots[info_step.collect]
185:                     ),
186:                     "description": info_step.description,
187:                 }
188:                 for info_step in top_flow.get_collect_steps()
189:                 if self.is_extractable(info_step, tracker, current_step)
190:             ]
191:         else:
192:             flow_slots = []
193: 
194:         collect_information, collect_information_description = (
195:             self.prepare_current_slot_for_template(current_step)
196:         )
197:         current_conversation = tracker_as_readable_transcript(tracker)
198:         latest_user_message = sanitize_message_for_prompt(message.get(TEXT))
199:         current_conversation += f"\nUSER: {latest_user_message}"
200: 
201:         inputs = {
202:             "available_flows": self.create_template_inputs(
203:                 flows_without_patterns, tracker
204:             ),
205:             "current_conversation": current_conversation,
206:             "flow_slots": flow_slots,
207:             "current_flow": top_flow.id if top_flow is not None else None,
208:             "collect_information": collect_information,
209:             "collect_information_description": collect_information_description,
210:             "user_message": latest_user_message,
211:         }
212: 
213:         return Template(self.prompt_template).render(**inputs)
214: 
215:     @staticmethod
216:     def prepare_current_slot_for_template(
217:         current_step: Optional[FlowStep],
218:     ) -> Tuple[Optional[str], Optional[str]]:
219:         """Prepare current collect slot information for the prompt template."""
220:         if isinstance(current_step, CollectInformationFlowStep):
221:             return current_step.collect, current_step.description
222: 
223:         return None, None
